# orionbelt_user (Resource)

A person who can sign in to the gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orionbelt_user" "engineer" {
  username = "eng-01"
  email    = "eng-01@example.com"
  role     = "user"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)
- `username` (String) Login name. Changing it replaces the user.

### Optional

- `public_key` (String) SSH public key in authorized_keys format.
- `role` (String) admin, operator, auditor or user. Default user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mfa_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user has enrolled TOTP. Users enrol themselves.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a user by its ID.
terraform import orionbelt_user.engineer <user_id>
```
